How to use the secret key

You need an authenticator app on your phone: it generates 6-digit codes that change every 30 seconds.

1. Tap "Open in my authenticator app", or copy the key by tapping it.
2. In the authenticator app choose to add an account with a setup key (manual key).
3. Paste the key and name it whatever you like, for example TRAZO.
4. Enter here the 6-digit code the app shows and tap "Enable 2FA".

Compatible apps: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis, 2FAS and Proton Authenticator. Any TOTP-compatible app works.

Once 2FA is on, save the recovery codes: they are the only way in if you lose your phone.

TRAZO will use what you tell it about injuries, pain, discomfort and illness only to adapt your training and, if you also turn on “Help improve TRAZO”, pain and discomfort too to study how to make plans better. It is optional: without it, everything else works the same. You can withdraw it at any time in Account, which erases that data.

Your injuries, pain and discomfort marks and illness reasons will be erased. Your training history stays. Your plan will no longer avoid the areas you had marked.

If you turn this on, TRAZO will use your training data (plans, sets, loads, repetitions, effort, pain and discomfort you log and, if you say it, why you archive a plan; without your name, email or notes) to compare engine versions and study how to make plans better. The data is replaced with keys that identify nobody outside each analysis, and results are read in groups. It is not sold or shared. If you delete your account, the anonymous per-muscle figures that are kept may be grouped. You can turn it off at any time: you will be left out of later analyses. Any reasons you gave for archiving plans are erased. It changes nothing you can use.
